provenance: Curated from primary papers, official repositories, model hubs, project pages, and explicit licence or access terms. The 2026-09-11 refresh follows the August catalog with discovery across all ten modalities and condition-focused re-review of all 39 previously held records. It adds 11 displayed records including two resolved family promotions and a separately evidenced family member, makes a targeted GPN-MSA lifecycle/publication update, and returns ALICE to HOLD after current official access could no longer be verified. The canonical displayed catalog contains 400 records; 44 unresolved candidates remain in the separate under-review register. Unchanged rows retain their prior verification dates. Generated distributions come from canonical JSON through a deterministic build.
evidence_statement: 400 records: 258 verified and 142 with visible limitations. September review covers new entries and all 39 previous holds; older verification dates are preserved. 44 candidates remain under review. Check each record's access and licence limitations before use.
